extraChanges.reason: The worksheet image model now uses OfficeLength. Semantic inventories carry bounded exact EMUs alongside pixel presentation values, retain signed native positions and marker offsets on import, and use valid pixel fallbacks when native metadata is invalid. Editable-layout image collision bounds use physical exclusive endpoints.
